google_auth_resolution.title: Google Authentication Issue Resolution
google_auth_resolution.summary: Successfully fixed Google OAuth configuration and authentication endpoints

issues_identified.issue: Missing Google OAuth JSON configuration file
issues_identified.description: The GOOGLE_OAUTH_JSON_PATH pointed to non-existent config/google_oauth.json
issues_identified.resolution: Updated .env to point to existing server/config/client_secret_*.json file

issues_identified.description: Frontend running on port 3001 but OAuth configured for port 3000
issues_identified.resolution: Updated OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI and FRONTEND_URL to use port 3001

issues_identified.description: Frontend proxy and backend server on different ports causing connection issues
issues_identified.resolution: Standardized both frontend and backend to use consistent port configuration

web/package.json: Proxy configuration updated from port 8001 to 8000
